goal: Reconcile I09 from a mandatory live-provider activation DAG to a dialog-driven, provider-neutral semantic maintenance architecture with external-spend default deny while preserving deterministic task-context correctness and historical provider-boundary evidence.

verified_facts.statement: Architecture Issue #64 was claimed from exact protected hwm-control/main 7b0aba37a81099da44bb3b702c558f8f2aa71ff0 on branch agent/infra-0064-i09-semantic-architecture-reconciliation only after Issue #62 was relinquished from claimed to blocked, so there is no competing active owner.

PR #63 historically merged the protected-main OpenAI WIF boundary at main SHA 7b0aba37a81099da44bb3b702c558f8f2aa71ff0 from exact final candidate 6c708c342cf0ae8e506c3466a0d68109cc198283, with PR-head Infrastructure CI 31973020315 and post-merge Infrastructure CI 31973057291 successful; the merge message and Issue #62 record explicitly left owner-side activation outstanding.

At reconciliation start the Trusted OpenAI Live workflow had zero recorded runs and repository Environments inventory was empty. Repository Actions variable-name metadata was not accessible to the integration (403), so no variable-name presence or absence was inferred and no secret or credential value was read.

verified_facts.statement: ADR 0004 already makes semantic output derived_non_authoritative behind a deterministic verifier and keeps deterministic task context independently usable; ADR 0005 and PR #63 implement only a separately activated provider-specific boundary and do not prove provider authorization or activation.
The first controlled-publisher architecture candidate was c685cdf8acfb6e3ecb741724063c1aaf71a37bda and exact-head Infrastructure CI run 31976572475 completed successfully.

decisions.decision: Make external spend and credentialed provider activation default-deny and require a separate durable owner authorization containing provider/capability, finite monetary cap plus enforcement, allowed operations/models, data boundary, execution/credential boundary, duration/review date, and revocation/cleanup.
decisions.rationale: Architecture or implementation references to a provider are not authorization to create billing, credentials, spend, or a new external data boundary. Missing authorization fields must fail closed without blocking deterministic infrastructure progress.

decisions.decision: Keep deterministic retrieval, exact task-context materialization, provenance, coverage, and deterministic validation as the mandatory I09 correctness path; provider absence is not an I09/I10+ blocker.
decisions.rationale: The deterministic path is already authoritative for source identity and correctness and ADR 0004 explicitly makes semantic availability convenience-only.

decisions.decision: Adopt a fresh browser-agent dialogue over one immutable semantic batch manifest as the initial semantic/wiki transport, with one READY Issue, one manifest, one conversation, one branch, one PR, and one Knowledge Delta; the user only launches the canonical prompt and is not an acceptance gate.
decisions.rationale: This preserves an auditable semantic maintenance path without creating provider credentials/spend and preserves the autonomous no-manual-check project model.

decisions.decision: Define hwm-semantic-batch-manifest/v1, hwm-semantic-batch-result/v1, and hwm-semantic-coverage/v1 as forward-only implementation targets with exact source/digest binding, total typed coverage, partition union proofs, prompt-injection/source-as-data controls, deterministic authority deny-list, and idempotent identity.
decisions.rationale: The batch envelopes must make semantic transport provider-neutral and verifiable without retroactively widening ADR 0004 contracts.

decisions.decision: Retain PR #63, ADR 0005, the trusted WIF workflow, and hwm-openai-live implementation as dormant historical evidence while superseding their activation objective as an I09 readiness dependency.
decisions.rationale: Historical implementation is valid audit evidence and may be reusable after a separate future provider opt-in, but it is neither completed activation nor current authorization.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Activate OpenAI/WIF, billing, credentials, or spend to complete the old #62/#50 DAG.
rejected_alternatives.reason: The owner explicitly did not authorize that path and deterministic I09 correctness does not depend on it.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Delete or rewrite ADR 0005, PR #63, or the historical I09-0062 Knowledge Delta.
rejected_alternatives.reason: That would destroy historical evidence instead of recording a forward architecture supersession.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Rewrite Issue #50 in place as the dialog-driven implementation task.
rejected_alternatives.reason: Its live-provider objective and dependency history should remain auditable; bounded replacement Issues preserve the migration.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Make the user manually inspect semantic sources, output, diff, CI, or merge.
rejected_alternatives.reason: The user is the trigger only; manual acceptance would regress the autonomous no-manual-check lifecycle.

P5R1 implements the provider-neutral semantic batch contracts and deterministic verifier; P5R2 later runs the first verified semantic maintenance batch in a separate fresh dialogue.
